exitSearch.result: No public company sale, FCC transfer of control, Tiger exit or signed pending sponsor transaction was found. Tiger continues to publish Crosslake as a portfolio company and Crosslake continues to describe itself as Tiger-backed. Operating expansions, route joint ventures and PoP partnerships are not treated as sponsor transfers.

responseSourceHealthCorrections: The FCC source supports a 93.26% indirect Tiger AIV interest at the 2018 regulatory disclosure date; it does not establish Tiger's current percentage or a current 100% ownership claim.
The 6.74% minority-holder group is historical disclosure only; its current composition and status are unresolved and it is not added as a named current manager owner.

Crosslake's current disclosure distinguishes 25+ backbone PoPs/data centres from dozens of extranet-connected sites, so the repository's undifferentiated greater-than-40 owned-PoP claim is not retained.

The 681-kilometre scale is the arithmetic sum of Crosslake's two named live systems, 131 kilometres and 550 kilometres; it excludes routes in development and does not imply that every extension or extranet connection is owned.
The 2017 Tiger release says an investment had been made but does not disclose a separate legal close date; December 7, 2017 is retained as the best public entry date with that limitation.
